patterns.name: Phase overview and repeated phase detail
continuity_rules: Stable phase IDs, order, labels and color meanings across every page.
Each detail page names its phase and maps back to one overview item.
One-to-three detail pages per phase express distinct roles: explanation, activity/output, evidence or decision.
Repeated detail pages must not silently duplicate or omit required content.

source_examples.relationship: Three-phase overview followed by recurring phase activity/output detail; supporting pages occur between phase detail pages.
source_examples.review_scope: Root individually inspected overview 22 and recurring phase detail pages 24, 28 and 34; three phase identities and activity/work-product structure align.

patterns.name: Product proposition to capability detail
continuity_rules: Carry product identity and value proposition through capability pages.
Use stable capability IDs and distinguish business outcomes from technical features.
A detail page must name its parent product/capability and required evidence.

source_examples.relationship: Technical and business product-overview variants lead into evidence-to-action detail and phase-by-phase evidence/decision detail.
source_examples.review_scope: All four images individually inspected; 44/45 share the main arrangement and should not inflate template count.

patterns.name: Architecture context to layer detail
continuity_rules: Preserve layer/component identities, hierarchy and relationship meaning.
Declare whether each page is business, logical technical, or physical/deployment architecture.
Show scope and boundary changes explicitly when zooming into a component.
Do not imply a component detail implements unproven automatic diagram routing.

source_examples.relationship: Layer/component overview introduces the populated architecture and subsequent layer-focused detail; recurring colors and miniature overview preserve context.
source_examples.review_scope: Root individually inspected the overview, populated architecture and two layer-focus detail pages.

patterns.name: Frame, claim, evidence and decision
continuity_rules: Each evidence page links to a claim ID.
Carry qualifications and source locators through summary and detailed versions.
Final decision follows the evidence without adding unsupported claims.
